author: Joltz_
body:
KTM- Kill The Monarchy

I thought of this as a gamemode for nebula, as I though DTM and TDM(OitN) wasn't enough, and so I thought of this

Kill the Monarchy-

How is it played? Normal Nebula DTM or TDM map, but building is disabled and each team has a King and Queen, and the opposing team has to kill them, The problem is, they will be guarded by the whole team.

2 ways to win:
Kill the monarchy
or
Have the most kills

replies.author: Phobiaxx
replies.body:
yah, allow building. and.. whoever becomes king will be bored out of their MINDS so... I suggest adding in an NCP, with a boss health bar at the top, for all players to see, there will be two bars.. one for each king. each king will have... say... 100HP. the king can only be hurt by the enemies.
HERES THE TWIST: in order to have the king regenerate his health...  the team will have to take redstone, labeled their team name, from the enemy base. The enemy will have 6 chests of redstone, and it cannot be touched by the enemy... each redstone regenerates 10 HP.  each chest has 1 redstone. Players are rewarded 5XP for capturing a redstone, and 5 more, for successfully delivering it to their king.
another twist... only up to 4 defenders are allowed within 8 blocks of the king.... :o
and... the king doesn't move.. he's fat and lazy :P
